notes.title: f32(count-1) would render a garbled frame IF a bundle row ever had count 0 (unreachable by construction)
notes.evidence: count := bundles.bundle_count[bi] ... width := (tier_pipe_width(v, tier) + f32(count-1)*BUNDLE_EXTRA_WIDTH) * v.scale
notes.detail: count is u32; count-1 wraps to 0xFFFFFFFF if count==0. A bundle row is only minted when >=1 live pipe is found and bundle_count is incremented in that same pass, so count>=1 always for iterated rows. Latent/unreachable today.
notes.recommended_fix: Optional hardening: f32(max(count,1)-1) or an assert, so a future invariant break surfaces cleanly. No bar to merge.

notes.title: Merge 'pop' is an instant width change, not an animated tween (AC says 'animation')
notes.evidence: width := (tier_pipe_width(v, tier) + f32(count-1)*BUNDLE_EXTRA_WIDTH) * v.scale  // no time/tween; instant f(count)
notes.detail: Story 2.1 AC: 'a merge "pop" animation'. Impl is an instant static width change (width=f(count), no tween). The slice-2 'pop' read (a fatter pooled link forming) is satisfied + golden-verified; animated juice is slice 7 (Story 7.1).
notes.recommended_fix: None for 2.1. An animated pop tween is slice-7 visual-juice territory. Flagged so the human is aware of the AC-vs-impl wording.

notes.title: Unused loop binder `i` in bundle_leg_transit (project idiom is `for _ in`)
notes.evidence: for i in 0..<parallel_pipes {\n\t\t\t\t_, _ = topology_apply_edit(&s.topology, Command{1, Cmd_Draw_Pipe{rt, host, std}}, cat)\n\t\t\t}
notes.detail: Outer loop binder `i` is unused in the body; the codebase idiom for an unused range binder is `for _ in` (rng_test.odin). Compiles clean (odin test core = 36/36); CI does not run -vet. Non-functional style nit.
notes.recommended_fix: Change `for i in 0..<parallel_pipes` to `for _ in 0..<parallel_pipes` to match convention.

notes.title: Defensive fallback branch (cap==0) in flow_step has no direct test
notes.detail: The primary lookup is FULL via test_bundle_resolves_via_representative_pipe. The `if cap == 0` fallback is exercised by no test; step() rebuilds bundles before flow_step so a live pipe's cap is never 0 (defensive-only, unreachable in normal flow).
